title: Total testosterone

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: A total testosterone test measures the amount of the hormone testosterone in your blood, including the part bound to proteins and the free part. Testosterone helps control sex drive and supports muscle and bone growth, and it is present in all sexes.
context: Testosterone levels are usually highest in the morning, so blood is often drawn between about 7 and 10 a.m. Levels normally decrease with age, and a result on its own cannot diagnose a condition.
aboveRange: In males, a higher level may be associated with a testicular tumor, steroid use, or an adrenal gland condition
In females, a higher level may be associated with PCOS, an ovarian condition, an adrenal gland condition, or a pituitary condition
belowRange: In males, a lower level may be associated with a condition of the testicles, pituitary gland, or another long-lasting illness, and it is also common with older age
In females, low levels are normal, though very low levels may be linked to an adrenal, pituitary, or ovarian condition
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
